=== .devcontainer/Dockerfile ===
# BEGIN U-BOOT MANAGED BLOCK: init
# Devcontainer image for u-boot-messung-ocloud-konto-alw — generated by `u-boot generate devcontainer`.
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/base:debian

# Non-root default user (LH-FA-DEV-004).
USER root
# Ollama (LH-FA-DEV-003): the CPU-only release archive of ollama/ollama.
# Version and checksums are pinned here, in one place; the build stops before
# the extraction unless the SHA-256 matches. The upstream publishes no
# signature: the check catches a release asset that was swapped later, not a
# release that was harmful from the start. The GPU libraries stay out of the
# image; `zstd` is installed for the extraction and removed in the same step.
# The image starts no server and sets no listen address. The model store
# belongs to the container user, so the named volume mounted there inherits
# that ownership.
ARG OLLAMA_VERSION=0.40.6
ARG OLLAMA_SHA256_AMD64=c164ab8b1b28e2a247c29719b8e404c423c5b83ae64c3ab4e59d50c7ff7fc5e0
ARG OLLAMA_SHA256_ARM64=0a279d9428ad17b06fdb7dddf3b059b2c148433585fa3b30676a102fc459bb9f
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends zstd \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
 && arch="$(dpkg --print-architecture)" \
 && case "$arch" in amd64) sha256="${OLLAMA_SHA256_AMD64}" ;; arm64) sha256="${OLLAMA_SHA256_ARM64}" ;; *) echo "ollama has no archive for $arch" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac \
 && work="$(mktemp -d)" \
 && cd "$work" \
 && curl -fsSLO "https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/download/v${OLLAMA_VERSION}/ollama-linux-${arch}.tar.zst" \
 && echo "${sha256}  ollama-linux-${arch}.tar.zst" | sha256sum -c - \
 && tar --zstd -xf "ollama-linux-${arch}.tar.zst" -C /usr/local --no-same-owner --exclude='lib/ollama/cuda_*' --exclude='lib/ollama/vulkan' \
 && cd / \
 && rm -rf "$work" \
 && apt-get purge -y --auto-remove zstd \
 && mkdir -p /home/vscode/.ollama \
 && chown vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.ollama
# Egress restriction (LH-FA-DEV-008).
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends dnsmasq-base nftables \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY egress-init.sh /usr/local/bin/u-boot-egress-init
# Status files of the container start scripts (LH-FA-DEV-007); `u-boot doctor`
# reads them from the host. The directory belongs to the container user so the
# `postCreateCommand` and the `sudo` scripts can write there.
RUN mkdir -p /var/lib/u-boot/status && chown vscode:vscode /var/lib/u-boot/status
# Sandbox profile (LH-FA-DEV-006): workspace lives in a named volume that
# inherits ownership from this directory.
RUN mkdir -p "/workspaces/u-boot-messung-ocloud-konto-alw" && chown vscode:vscode "/workspaces/u-boot-messung-ocloud-konto-alw"
# Git credentials come from $GIT_TOKEN at runtime (LH-FA-DEV-009); nothing is stored in the image.
RUN git config --system credential.helper '!f() { test -n "$GIT_TOKEN" && printf "username=x-access-token\npassword=%s\n" "$GIT_TOKEN"; }; f'
USER vscode
# END U-BOOT MANAGED BLOCK: init
=== .devcontainer/devcontainer.json ===
// BEGIN U-BOOT MANAGED BLOCK: init
{
  "name": "u-boot-messung-ocloud-konto-alw",
  "build": {
    "dockerfile": "./Dockerfile",
    "context": "."
  },
  "workspaceMount": "",
  "workspaceFolder": "/workspaces/u-boot-messung-ocloud-konto-alw",
  "runArgs": ["--cap-add=NET_ADMIN", "--add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway"],
  "mounts": [
    "source=u-boot-messung-ocloud-konto-alw-workspace-${devcontainerId},target=/workspaces/u-boot-messung-ocloud-konto-alw,type=volume",
    "source=u-boot-messung-ocloud-konto-alw-ollama-${devcontainerId},target=/home/vscode/.ollama,type=volume"
  ],
  "postStartCommand": "sudo sh /usr/local/bin/u-boot-egress-init",
  "remoteEnv": {
    "GIT_TOKEN": "${localEnv:GIT_TOKEN}",
    "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "${localEnv:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}"
  },
  "features": {
    "ghcr.io/anthropics/devcontainer-features/claude-code:1": {},
    "ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/node:1": {}
  },
  "remoteUser": "vscode"
}
// END U-BOOT MANAGED BLOCK: init
=== .devcontainer/egress-init.sh ===
# BEGIN U-BOOT MANAGED BLOCK: init
# Egress restriction (LH-FA-DEV-008, ADR-0012), run by `postStartCommand`
# via `sudo sh`. A guardrail, not a sandbox boundary. Generated by
# `u-boot generate devcontainer`; extend the allowlist with
# `u-boot config set devcontainer.sandbox.egress.allow <host>`.
#
# Mechanism: a local dnsmasq resolves only the allowed names and adds the
# answers to an nftables set; everything else is dropped by nftables. Port 53
# to the upstream resolvers is open only for the user of that dnsmasq.
# Policy devcontainer.sandbox.onUnavailable: warn
on_unavailable="warn"
hosts="api.anthropic.com api.github.com codeload.github.com dd20bb891979d25aebc8bec07b2b3bbc.r2.cloudflarestorage.com deb.debian.org github.com host.docker.internal objects.githubusercontent.com raw.githubusercontent.com registry.npmjs.org registry.ollama.ai security.debian.org"
status_dir=/var/lib/u-boot/status

# Writes the status file `u-boot doctor` reads: ok | fallback | failed.
# The file is replaced as a whole; a write error never changes the exit code.
write_status() {
  [ -d "$status_dir" ] || return 0
  tmp="$status_dir/.egress.$$"
  { printf 'u-boot-status 1\nresult=%s\nat=%s\n' "$1" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > "$tmp" && mv -f "$tmp" "$status_dir/egress"; } 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$tmp"
  return 0
}

# Without the NET_ADMIN capability nftables cannot be used.
if ! nft list tables >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "u-boot sandbox: egress restriction unavailable (NET_ADMIN not granted); consider restricting egress at network or DNS level" >&2
  if [ "$on_unavailable" = "fail" ]; then
    write_status failed
    exit 11
  fi
  write_status fallback
  exit 0
fi

# The dnsmasq user is set once: `user=` in the configuration and `meta skuid`
# in the upstream rules read the same value. A missing user, a dnsmasq that
# does not start and one that runs under another uid end in exit 11 under
# every onUnavailable policy.
dns_user=nobody
dns_uid=$(id -u "$dns_user" 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "$dns_uid" ]; then
  echo "u-boot sandbox: egress restriction not set up: the user '$dns_user' for the local resolver does not exist" >&2
  write_status failed
  exit 11
fi

# Keep the original resolver configuration (restart-safe).
[ -f /etc/resolv.conf.u-boot-orig ] || cp /etc/resolv.conf /etc/resolv.conf.u-boot-orig
upstreams=$(awk '/^nameserver/ && $2 !~ /:/ {print $2}' /etc/resolv.conf.u-boot-orig)
pidfile=/run/u-boot-egress-dnsmasq.pid
conf=/etc/u-boot-egress-dnsmasq.conf
rules=/run/u-boot-egress.nft

# True when the process no longer exists or is a zombie (a container without
# an init process does not reap it).
process_gone() {
  [ ! -d "/proc/$1" ] || [ "$(awk '/^State:/ {print $2}' "/proc/$1/status" 2>/dev/null)" = "Z" ]
}

{
  echo "listen-address=127.0.0.1"
  echo "bind-interfaces"
  echo "no-resolv"
  echo "no-hosts"
  echo "user=$dns_user"
  echo "pid-file=$pidfile"
  for h in $hosts; do
    for ns in $upstreams; do echo "server=/$h/$ns"; done
    echo "nftset=/$h/4#ip#u_boot_egress#allowed"
  done
} > "$conf"

# Re-run safe: both tables are replaced in one `nft -f` transaction. The input
# starts with `add table` (a no-op when the table exists) and `delete table`
# for each table, then builds it anew, so there is no state without a table
# between the old and the new rule set; a transaction that fails changes
# nothing and ends the script with exit 11. The set `allowed` starts empty.
{
  echo "add table ip u_boot_egress"
  echo "delete table ip u_boot_egress"
  echo "add table ip u_boot_egress"
  echo "add set ip u_boot_egress allowed { type ipv4_addr; flags timeout; timeout 1h; }"
  echo "add chain ip u_boot_egress output { type filter hook output priority 0; policy drop; }"
  echo "add rule ip u_boot_egress output oifname lo accept"
  echo "add rule ip u_boot_egress output ct state established,related accept"
  echo "add rule ip u_boot_egress output ip daddr @allowed accept"
  for ns in $upstreams; do
    echo "add rule ip u_boot_egress output meta skuid $dns_uid ip daddr $ns udp dport 53 accept"
    echo "add rule ip u_boot_egress output meta skuid $dns_uid ip daddr $ns tcp dport 53 accept"
  done
  echo "add table ip6 u_boot_egress6"
  echo "delete table ip6 u_boot_egress6"
  echo "add table ip6 u_boot_egress6"
  echo "add chain ip6 u_boot_egress6 output { type filter hook output priority 0; policy drop; }"
  echo "add rule ip6 u_boot_egress6 output oifname lo accept"
} > "$rules"
if ! nft -f "$rules"; then
  echo "u-boot sandbox: egress restriction failed: the nftables rules could not be applied (a previous rule set stays in place)" >&2
  write_status failed
  exit 11
fi

# Resolver switch: the new configuration is written; the old resolver is
# stopped and awaited for at most 5 seconds (both bind 127.0.0.1:53), then the
# new one starts. The message of a failed start names an old resolver that is
# still running.
old_alive=
if [ -f "$pidfile" ]; then
  old_pid=$(cat "$pidfile")
  kill "$old_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
  waited=0
  while [ "$waited" -lt 50 ] && ! process_gone "$old_pid"; do
    sleep 0.1
    waited=$((waited + 1))
  done
  process_gone "$old_pid" || old_alive=1
fi
rm -f "$pidfile"

if ! dnsmasq --conf-file="$conf"; then
  echo "u-boot sandbox: egress restriction failed: the local resolver did not start${old_alive:+ (the previous resolver was still running after 5 seconds)}" >&2
  write_status failed
  exit 11
fi
# The upstream rules name one uid; a resolver under another uid would be blocked.
running_uid=$(awk '/^Uid:/ {print $2}' "/proc/$(cat "$pidfile" 2>/dev/null)/status" 2>/dev/null)
if [ "$running_uid" != "$dns_uid" ]; then
  echo "u-boot sandbox: egress restriction failed: the local resolver is not running as '$dns_user' (uid $dns_uid)" >&2
  write_status failed
  exit 11
fi
echo "nameserver 127.0.0.1" > /etc/resolv.conf
write_status ok
# END U-BOOT MANAGED BLOCK: init
